correctness.rationale: For r>=3 a shattered support requires a private prime-power separator for every co-singleton; no prime can serve two different indices. Conversely distinct private primes realize all nonempty traces by compatible cosets, and the singleton outside supplies the empty trace. Local p-adic common-prefix counts give B_r and CRT plus inclusion-exclusion gives every coefficient. The exceptional n=1,2 boundaries are checked. Direct independent enumerations support all critical local and global counts; see VERIFY.py and VERIFICATION.md.

value.rationale: The object is a canonical algebraic range space formed from every cyclic quotient, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Its exact infinite-family shattering polynomial decomposes into local prime-power data; the private-prime criterion explains the VC dimension and a natural arithmetic top coefficient \(n\varphi(n)\) for squarefree moduli. The coefficientwise answer goes beyond merely computing a small example or repeating a known boundedness principle.
